owner_requirements: gb_feedback_0720/0740: primary = the a/b/c gate vs frozen v0.0.13 on NEW seeds; one change: hit-and-stay-up reward; preregistration lands as its own PR before the run; tag only if the primary passes; nice 19, loadavg < 86
question: Does rewarding a head/torso hit only when the athlete stays up 0.5 s afterwards keep v0.0.18's real hits while restoring balance, so that the policy beats the frozen v0.0.13 champion with hits on fresh seeds?
context: v0.0.18 (159642dd): head/torso hits 24/24 but stance 1/24; lost 13-31 to frozen v0.0.16 by hitting then falling first; addendum gate vs v0.0.13 (6ea4b7e1) passed 48-0 on seeds 4000-4023 (cycle-0024). v0.0.18 bundled two changes (F3); v0.0.19 changes ONE thing: the fitness.
classification: single-athlete motor diagnostic in the shared two-person world; not boxing, not self-play, not an Elo claim
env: grokbot.scenarios.RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000); unchanged jekko env; runs to the horizon (does not stop at the first fall)
opponent: frozen v0.0.11 gen4 posture policy (deterministic) in corner B
change: ONLY the training fitness: stand_ticks/3000 + 1.0 * motor_gate.hit_and_stayed_up(result, 500), i.e. the bonus needs a head/torso hit (ContactClassifier.scoring_by) AND stand_ticks >= first_scoring_tick + 500

training.method: grokbot.motor_gate.train antithetic ES with CRN against the frozen gen4 posture

gate.stance_pass: candidate stands (no persistent non-foot floor support) for the full 3000 ticks
gate.reach_pass: candidate lands >= 1 strike tick (approach and referee active speed >= 0.5 m/s on a strike target)
gate.also_reported: scoring_reach_rate (share of trials with >= 1 head/torso hit); not part of the primary gate

primary.name: Elo/win-rate gate vs frozen v0.0.13 on NEW seeds

head_to_head.env: grokbot.reference_env.ReferenceEndingEnv(RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000), anti_stalling=True) via grokbot.selfplay.play_game (ending v2, unchanged)
head_to_head.candidate: the trained v0.0.19 GroupPDPolicy, eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.opponent: frozen v0.0.13 champion: kind punch, punch_params(v0.0.11 gen4, onset=-3.0, duration=0.0, amplitude=2.0), eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.sides: each seed with the candidate in corner A and in corner B (48 games)
head_to_head.valid: grokbot.selfplay.valid_result; every game stays in the denominator
head_to_head.elo: Elo = 400*log10(p/(1-p)) with p = (1+mean)/2 clipped to [0.5/n, 1-0.5/n]; Elo lower bound from p_low = (1+lower95)/2 (-inf if p_low <= 0); win rate with a Wilson 95% interval (descriptive)
head_to_head.pass: ALL of: (a) valid games >= 50% of the 48; (b) lower95 > 0 (Elo lower bound > 0); (c) at least half of the candidate's valid wins include >= 1 candidate head/torso hit

primary.level_up: v0.0.19 is a level-up (tagged v0.0.19) iff this primary passes: (a) valid >= 50% of 48 AND (b) lower95 > 0 AND (c) >= half of the candidate's valid wins with >= 1 candidate head/torso hit

secondary_reported_not_gating.baseline_same_seeds: v0.0.18 final_params on the identical primary head-to-head (seeds 5000-5023 vs frozen v0.0.13), for context; not seen before this registration
secondary_reported_not_gating.non_regression_vs_v0016: v0.0.19 AND v0.0.18 each vs frozen v0.0.16 (kind group, v0.0.16 final_params, eval noise 0.05) on fresh seeds 6000-6023, both sides (48 games each), same statistics; reported: valid share, W-L, mean, lower95, Elo; improvement = v0.0.19 seed-paired mean minus v0.0.18 seed-paired mean on these seeds (positive = better)
secondary_reported_not_gating.motor_gate: stance/reach/scoring_reach/median stand on the 24 gate seeds; v0.0.18 gate re-run and checked per trial against its committed summary (determinism); exact sign test on stand ticks v0.0.19 vs v0.0.18, p < 0.05

red_team_note: v0.0.18 already passed this primary gate on other seeds (cycle-0024), so passing it shows v0.0.19 did not lose v0.0.18's hits; the last TAGGED version (v0.0.17) fails it (0 hits). The v0.0.16 non-regression and motor numbers are reported so a pass is not over-read.
pre_declared_readings: primary passes, v0.0.16 improvement > 0: the stay-up reward kept hits and improved balance under contact; tag v0.0.19; next preregister a two-player league seeded from it
primary passes, v0.0.16 improvement <= 0: tag (primary passed) but report that the fitness change did not help vs a standing opponent
primary fails on (c): the stay-up condition traded hits away; next: lengthen training or lower the stay-up window
primary fails on (a) or (b): regression vs v0.0.18; report and revert to v0.0.18 as the base
